newsitem.title: UK: Elderly British widow dies on doorstep.
newsitem.headline: Elderly British widow dies on doorstep.

text.p: An elderly widow on Saturday became the latest victim of the big chill gripping Britain and forecasters warned that the Arctic conditions could last for several more days.
Audrey Banks, 90, was found on her doorstep on the Isle of Wight by local milkman John Alcock.
"I was taking a bottle of milk to her house and found her frozen body curled up near the doorstep. It broke my heart as she was such a lovely old lady," he told reporters.
Britain has been hit by the coldest weather since the big freeze of 1963 and forecasters say milder conditions will not return until next weekend.
Bookmakers William Hill have cut their odds on the River Thames freezing over between Westminster and Tower Bridges in London for the first time this century from 200-1 to 20-1.
"With the Thames already frozen in other places and the big freeze continuing we are taking no chances and have slashed the odds," said a spokesman.
